calm.start: Off we go. {clinic} is expecting {pet}, so the hard part is already behind you — this bit is just the tail end.

calm.arrival: You made it. Tell the front desk you're the Tími arrival for {pet}. Nicely done — that was a fetching bit of driving.

urgent.arrival: You've arrived. Tell the front desk you're the Tími arrival for {pet}.

emergency.start: Heading to {clinic} now. They are expecting {pet}. Drive safely.
